Pepper's dinner after a long day of Tony

Dry-brined rib eye seared and butter-basted, rested and sliced with punchy chimichurri and crisp smashed baby potatoes with garlic and rosemary. Salt 4 rib eye steaks and refrigerate uncovered overnight. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes with garlic and rosemary. Chop a bunch of parsley, 1 tbsp oregano, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with a circle of blue buttercream and a white centre piped like the reactor.
K: Tony's bar in the Malibu workshop

Blended Scotch shaken with lemon and honey ginger syrup, poured over a big cube and finished with a float of smoky single malt and candied ginger. Simmer 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp water and 2cm sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Shake 200ml blended Scotch, 80ml fresh lemon juice and the syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over one large cube each. Float 10ml peaty single malt on each and garnish with a piece of candied ginger.

s.how: Fry 16 wonton wrappers at 180C until crisp. Dice 250g sashimi tuna and dress with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, lime juice and spring onion. Spoon onto the wontons, add a dot of smashed avocado and toasted sesame.

Mix 300g flour, 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 tsp baking powder and salt to a soft dough. Roll into 6 thin rounds and cook in a dry hot pan until blistered. Brush with 50g butter melted with garlic. Serve with a tub of hummus.

m.note: the first thing he wants after the cave
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls and smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with a slice of American cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack 2 per toasted bun with diced onion, pickles, yellow mustard and tomato sauce.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint half blue, pipe a blue ring with a white centre.

d.note: Tony's bar in the Malibu workshop
d.how: Simmer 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp water and 2cm sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Shake 200ml blended Scotch, 80ml fresh lemon juice and the syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
